items.question: Which mantra endings and initial materials must accompany the arghya offering in this ritual act?
premises: The heart-mantra is applied with an ending in svāhā.
The arghya offering is presented as part of this ritual action.
The arghya is characterized as beginning with dūrvā.
The ritual formula is concluded with vauṣaṭ.
items.inference: The arghya offering is to be performed with the heart-mantra ending in svāhā and with materials beginning with dūrvā, concluding with vauṣaṭ.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic scope of ca in linking hṛdā and arghyaṃ is slightly ambiguous.
items.plain_english: With the heart-mantra ending in svāhā, the arghya offering, beginning with dūrvā, is to be given and concluded with vauṣaṭ.
